tasks.CheckArtShow: Evaluate if the art show is a suitable place to put a picture frame vertically or not.
tasks.CheckCar: Verify if putting the picture frame in a car is an appropriate solution for non-vertical placement.
tasks.CheckNewspaper: Determine if placing the picture frame on a newspaper makes sense in this context.
tasks.CheckTable: Evaluate the possibility of placing the picture frame on a table horizontally.
tasks.CheckWall: Assess whether hanging the picture frame on a wall horizontally is feasible.
